title: No Sew Face Mask in 10 Steps
author: Julia Borden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be2jjgcn
materials: You now have a finished mask!

steps.title: Prepare T-shirt
steps.instruction: Lay out a clean t-shirt with a circular collar and remove the tag if present.

substeps.instruction: Lay out a clean t-shirt with a circular collar
Cut off the tag, if there is one

steps.title: Mark Back Dimensions
steps.instruction: Flip the shirt to the back and mark the cutting lines based on measurements.

substeps.instruction: Flip over the shirt so the back is facing you
Measure ~6 inches from the center of the collar
Draw a line at the 6 inch mark across the shirt and sleeves
Measure out ~4 inches from the collar across the shoulder
Draw a curved line from the 4-inch shoulder mark to about 1 inch from the top of the line on the sleeve

steps.title: Mark Front Dimensions
steps.instruction: Flip the shirt to the front and mark the curved cutting line.

substeps.instruction: Flip over the shirt so the front is facing you
Mark ~2 inches below the center of the collar
Draw a curved line from the 2-inch mark to the 4-inch marks on the shoulders

steps.title: Cut Fabric
steps.instruction: Cut the fabric along all the marked lines.

steps.title: Add Optional Filter Pocket
steps.instruction: Create and attach a pocket for extra fabric or filters.

substeps.instruction: Cut out a 4 inches x 5 inches piece of fabric
Place it in the center of the facemask, with the top almost touching the top of the collar
Sew this pocket onto the facemask

steps.title: Fit and Secure Mask
steps.instruction: Position the mask on the face and head and secure it.

substeps.instruction: Place the back collar over your nose, with the front collar hugging the back of your head
Use a pin or rubber band to tightly secure the collar on the back of your head if needed
Pull the two flaps tightly around your chin and secure on the top of your head with a knot

steps.title: Sterilize Mask
steps.instruction: Sterilize the mask using boiling water.

substeps.instruction: Place in boiling water for 10 minutes
